/* ==========================================================================
   Header
   ========================================================================== */
html {
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
}
body .container {
  width: 90%;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
body .background {
  margin: 0;
  display: inline-block;
}
body .hero,
body .hero-subpage {
  display: -ms-flexbox;
  display: -webkit-flex;
  display: -webkit-box;
  display: flex;
  -webkit-flex-direction: row;
  -ms-flex-direction: row;
  flex-direction: row;
  -webkit-justify-content: flex-start;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  -webkit-align-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  color: black;
  background: transparent !important;
  font: normal normal 900 20px 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
body .breadcrumbs-holder {
  padding: 0 5px;
  margin-bottom: 2em;
}
body .breadcrumbs-holder .breadcrumbs {
  margin: 1em 0 10px 0;
  font: normal normal 400 11px 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
  color: #434343;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
body .breadcrumbs-holder .breadcrumbs a {
  font: normal normal 400 11px 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
  color: #999;
  text-decoration: none;
}
body .breadcrumbs-holder .breadcrumbs a:hover {
  color: #434343;
}
body .breadcrumbs-holder .breadcrumbs a span {
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  display-inline: inline-block;
  padding: 0 .5em;
}
body .breadcrumbs-holder .breadcrumbs .home {
  padding-left: 0;
}
body .breadcrumbs-holder .breadcrumbs .home span {
  padding-left: 0;
}
body .breadcrumbs-holder .breadcrumbs span:last-child {
  font-weight: bold;
  display-inline: inline-block;
  padding: 0 .5em;
}
body .hidden-xs {
  display: none;
}
body .hidden-sm,
body .hidden-md {
  display: block;
}
@media screen and (min-width: 740px) {
  body .container {
    width: 90%;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
  body .background {
    width: 740px;
    padding: 0 10px;
  }
  body .hero,
  body .hero-subpage {
    font: normal normal 900 40px 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
  }
  body .hidden-xs {
    display: block;
  }
  body .hidden-sm,
  body .hidden-md {
    display: none;
  }
  body .breadcrumbs-holder {
    padding: 0;
  }
}
@media screen and (min-width: 960px) {

    width: 90%;

  }

    width: 100%;

  }
}
blockquote {
  background: #eee;
  font-size: 120%;
  padding: .25em 4%;
  border-radius: 5px;
  margin: 0 2%;
}
.checkbox-square {
  margin-right: 5px;
  display: inline-block;
}
.checkbox-square input[type="checkbox"],
.checkbox-square input[type="radio"] {
  visibility: hidden;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
}
.checkbox-square input[type="checkbox"] + label,
.checkbox-square input[type="radio"] + label {
  width: 19px;
  height: 19px;
  display: inline-block;
  border: 1px solid #8d8c94;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.checkbox-square input[type="checkbox"]:checked + label span,
.checkbox-square input[type="radio"]:checked + label span {
  position: absolute;
  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;
  top: 0;
  background: #f0c01d;
  display: inline-block;
}

.map {
  position: relative;
}
.map #map {
  width: 320px;
  height: 400px;
  margin: 0 auto 20px auto;
}
.map .shadow {
  width: 320px;
  height: 50px;
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 2;
}
.map .shadow.top {
  background: url('https://www.tradeplace.com/wp-content/themes/tradeplace/media/images/map-border.png') transparent no-repeat;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
}
.map .shadow.bottom {
  background: url('https://www.tradeplace.com/wp-content/themes/tradeplace/media/images/map-border.png') transparent center bottom no-repeat;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
}
.map .shadow.left {
  width: 50px;
  height: 400px;
  background: url('https://www.tradeplace.com/wp-content/themes/tradeplace/media/images/map-border.png') transparent left top no-repeat;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
}
.map .shadow.right {
  width: 50px;
  height: 400px;
  background: url('https://www.tradeplace.com/wp-content/themes/tradeplace/media/images/map-border.png') transparent top right;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
}
@media screen and (min-width: 740px) {
  .map #map {
    width: 720px;
    height: 740px;
    margin: 40px auto 60px auto;
  }
  .map .shadow {
    width: 720px;
  }
  .map .shadow.left {
    height: 740px;
  }
  .map .shadow.right {
    height: 740px;
  }
}
@media screen and (min-width: 960px) {
  .map #map {
    width: 890px;
  }
  .map .shadow {
    width: 900px;
  }
}

<h2><a href="https://www.tradeplace.com/en/specialised-dataformat-launch-at-the-2019-ifa-in-berlin-6-11-september/">Specialised dataformat launched at the 2019 IFA in Berlin</a></h2>
<div class="blog-meta"><span class="date">September 3, 2019 10:20 am</span>
<span class="author">Published by <strong>

                                        
                                        Justus Pieke                                    </strong></span>
</div>
<div class="excerpt">
                               ERP systems that operate in the built-in kitchen appliance sector have implemented an IDM interface to import product data. Now that IDM is part of PIMS, Tradeplace can offer more accurate product information to trading partners and kitchen planning software vendors active in this sector                               <a class="view-article" href="https://www.tradeplace.com/en/specialised-dataformat-launch-at-the-2019-ifa-in-berlin-6-11-september/">

</div>

</a>

<div class="information">
<h2><a href="https://www.tradeplace.com/en/miele-netherlands-product-information-now-available-on-tradeplace/">Miele Netherlands Product Information now available on Tradeplace</a></h2>
<div class="blog-meta"><span class="date">July 25, 2019 9:16 am</span>
<span class="author">Published by <strong>

                                        
                                        Justus Pieke                                    </strong></span>
</div>
<div class="excerpt">
                               Tradeplace’s PIMS allows manufacturers to share accurate and up-to-date product information with retailers, and is free of charge for retailers. All product information originates with the manufacturer which is considered industry-wide to be the most reliable.                               <a class="view-article" href="https://www.tradeplace.com/en/miele-netherlands-product-information-now-available-on-tradeplace/">

				hash = hashes[i].split('=');
				vars.push(hash[0]);
				vars[hash[0]] = hash[1];
			}
		return vars;
		}
